name: agent-evaluator-release-gate
title: Agent 稳定性与有效性 Benchmark
description: 用已建成的 QMSum + ExplainMeetSum 会议题库（data/meeting_gold/final），对当前线上版本（main）的 Agent 跑一次可复现的 benchmark：48 题（具体 30、概括 10、故障 8）每题 3 次，共 144 次运行；按预期轨迹规则 T1–T8 检查每次运行的工具调用过程，并报告有效性（答出率、证据命中/覆盖、引用命中/精确、故障恢复率）和稳定性（同题一致率、出错率、延迟 p50/p95、token 用量）。不做版本对比和发布门禁。
creator: lane
notes: In progress since 2026-10-07. Code is developed in worktree .runtime/worktrees/agent-benchmark (branch feat/agent-benchmark from origin/main 7418262); app/ must stay untouched. Decisions: LLM answer scoring yes (OpenAI judge + ~10 human spot checks); 48 questions x 3; fault questions yes; no constructed no-answer questions. A/B release-gate plan archived under research/archived-release-gate-plan-2026-10-07/. Ask before committing and before the real 144-run benchmark.
